newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian 88 to mail Morrison offer.
newsitem.headline: Canadian 88 to mail Morrison offer.

text.p: Canadian 88 Energy Corp expects to mail its formal offer for Morrison Petroleums Ltd on Wednesday, Canadian 88 chief executive Greg Noval said on Tuesday.
The mailing of the document starts the countdown of 21 days for Morrison shareholders to consider the unsolicited C$652 million cash and stock bid for the company.
Canadian 88 plans to offer C$10 cash, to a maximum of C$140 million, or 1.5 of its shares for each Morrison share.

Noval said late Tuesday he had yet to speak to Morrison chairman Gordon Stollery about the offer, although he said he believed Morrison suspected a bid after the company's shareholder list was requested about 10 days ago.

Morrison late last week announced it was instituting a shareholder rights plan or "poison pill," which would allow shareholders to purchase stock at half the market price and extend the period to attract higher offers to 60 days.
Canadian 88's offer is contingent on the poison pill being tossed out.
"They've seen this thing coming over the last 10 days or so, so it's no surprise. That's why they put in their pill," he said.
Noval said feedback over Canadian 88's proposal from several brokerages and mutual funds across North America contacted Monday and Tuesday was supportive.
